def native_mfa_group_members(index, group_id):
    """Accept only the exact completed native transitive-user projection."""
    kind = 'conditional_access_group_membership'
    expected_scope = scope(index).rstrip('/') + '/groups/' + group_id
    envelopes = [env for env in get(index, 'collections', dict).get(kind, [])
                 if get(env, 'scope', str).casefold() == expected_scope.casefold()]
    # Completeness belongs to this exact requested group. An unrelated group
    # failure cannot invalidate an independently complete MFA policy proof.
    own_index = {'context': get(index, 'context', dict),
                 'collections': {kind: envelopes},
                 kind: [wrapped for wrapped in index.get(kind, [])
                        if get(wrapped, 'scope', str).casefold() == expected_scope.casefold()]}
    rows = inventory(own_index, kind, graph=True)
    row = one(rows, 'group_id', group_id)
    if (len(envelopes) != 1 or get(envelopes[0], 'status', str) != 'collected'
            or get(envelopes[0], 'service', str) != 'Microsoft.Graph'
            or get(envelopes[0], 'items', list) != [row]
            or get(row, 'id', str).casefold() != group_id):
        raise Unavailable('native group source or reference binding unresolved')
    proof = get(row, '_provenance', dict)
    expected = {
        'requested_group_id': group_id,
        'source_operation': 'Groups_TransitiveMembers_List',
        'endpoint': '/v1.0/groups/' + group_id + '/transitiveMembers',
        'group_metadata_endpoint': '/v1.0/groups/' + group_id + '?$select=id,visibility,groupTypes,membershipRuleProcessingState',
        'representation': 'complete_transitive_user_ids',
    }
    if (get(proof, 'tenant_verified', bool) is not True
            or get(proof, 'read_only', bool) is not True
            or any(get(proof, key, str) != value for key, value in expected.items())):
        raise Unavailable('native group authority or projection unresolved')
    members = strings(get(row, 'user_ids', list))
    guid = r'[0-9a-f]{8}(?:-[0-9a-f]{4}){3}-[0-9a-f]{12}'
    if (any(not re.fullmatch(guid, value, re.I) for value in members)
            or members != sorted({value.casefold() for value in members})):
        raise Unavailable('native group user identities unresolved')
    return set(members)

def native_mfa_source_capture(index, kind):
    """Bind each independently relied-on native source to this tenant capture."""
    endpoints = {
        'conditional_access_policy': '/v1.0/identity/conditionalAccess/policies',
        'directory_user': '/v1.0/users',
        'directory_security_defaults': '/v1.0/policies/identitySecurityDefaultsEnforcementPolicy',
        'authentication_strength': '/v1.0/policies/authenticationStrengthPolicies',
    }
    metadata = get(index, 'context.metadata', dict)
    tenant = scope(index).removeprefix('/tenants/').casefold()
    if (get(metadata, 'tenant_verified', bool) is not True
            or get(metadata, 'tenant_id', str).casefold() != tenant):
        raise Unavailable('native MFA tenant authority unresolved')
    capture = {key: text(get(metadata, key, str))
               for key in ('credential_context_id', 'customer_context_id')}
    envelopes = get(index, 'collections', dict).get(kind, [])
    if (len(envelopes) != 1
            or get(envelopes[0], 'scope', str).casefold() != scope(index).casefold()
            or get(envelopes[0], 'service', str) != 'Microsoft.Graph'):
        raise Unavailable('native MFA source scope ambiguous')
    def captured(proof, *, row=False):
        if (get(proof, 'tenant_verified', bool) is not True
                or get(proof, 'tenant_id', str).casefold() != tenant
                or any(get(proof, key, str) != value for key, value in capture.items())
                or ((row or 'read_only' in proof) and get(proof, 'read_only', bool) is not True)):
            raise Unavailable('native MFA source capture or authority unresolved')
        if row and get(proof, 'endpoint', str) != endpoints[kind]:
            raise Unavailable('native MFA source endpoint unresolved')
        if row and kind == 'authentication_strength' and (
                get(proof, 'source_operation', str) != 'authenticationStrengthPolicies_List'
                or get(proof, 'representation', str) != 'full'):
            raise Unavailable('native MFA strength projection unresolved')
    captured(get(envelopes[0], '_provenance', dict))
    for row in inventory(index, kind, graph=True):
        captured(get(row, '_provenance', dict), row=True)

def _arm_scope(row, projection, tenant):
    props = row.get('properties')
    _require(isinstance(props, dict), 'ARM assignment properties missing')
    scope = props.get('scope')
    _require(isinstance(scope, str) and scope == scope.strip() and not any(c in scope for c in ('?', '#', '%')) and not any(v in ('.', '..') for v in scope.split('/')), 'ARM grant scope missing or malformed')
    rid = row.get('id')
    _require(isinstance(rid, str), 'ARM grant identity missing')
    match_id = re.fullmatch(re.escape(scope.rstrip('/')) + r'/providers/Microsoft.Authorization/(roleAssignments|roleAssignmentScheduleInstances|roleEligibilityScheduleInstances)/([0-9a-f-]{36})', rid, re.I)
    _require(match_id is not None and _guid(match_id.group(2)) == _guid(row.get('name'))
             and str(row.get('type', '')).casefold() == ('Microsoft.Authorization/' + match_id.group(1)).casefold(), 'ARM grant identity differs from scope/type/name')
    if scope == '/':
        return props
    match = re.match(r'(/subscriptions/[0-9a-f-]{36})(?:/|$)', scope, re.I)
    mg = re.fullmatch(r'/providers/Microsoft.Management/managementGroups/[^/?#]+', scope, re.I)
    _require(match or mg, 'unsupported ARM hierarchy scope')
    parent = match.group(1) if match else mg.group(0)
    if match:
        _guid(parent.rsplit('/', 1)[1])
    values = _source(projection, 'binding:' + parent.casefold())
    _require(len(values) == 1 and str(values[0].get('id', '')).casefold() == parent.casefold(), 'ARM parent identity differs')
    actual_tenant = values[0].get('tenantId') if match else values[0].get('properties', {}).get('tenantId')
    _require(_guid(actual_tenant) == tenant, 'ARM assignment belongs to another tenant')
    return props

def _principal_ids(item, index):
    uid = _guid(item['id'])
    groups = _unique(_inventory(index, 'directory_group'))
    memberships = _inventory(index, 'directory_user_group_membership')
    own = [r for r in memberships if str(r.get('id', '')).casefold() == uid]
    _require(len(own) == 1 and str(own[0].get('userId', '')).casefold() == uid
             and own[0].get('_coverage', {}).get('groups', {}).get('status') in ('collected', 'empty'), 'user membership incomplete')
    result = {uid}
    _require(isinstance(own[0].get('groups'), list), 'native user group list missing')
    for group in own[0]['groups']:
        _require(isinstance(group, dict), 'malformed user group reference')
        gid = _guid(group.get('id'))
        _require(gid in groups, 'membership group absent from native inventory')
        raw = groups[gid]
        kinds = raw.get('groupTypes')
        _require(isinstance(kinds, list) and not any(k not in ('Unified',) for k in kinds) and raw.get('visibility') in (None, 'Private', 'Public'), 'hidden, dynamic or malformed membership unresolved')
        result.add(gid)
    return result, groups

def _rows(reader, request, endpoint, *, graph=True, opaque=False):
    """Preserve every page and reject duplicates before shared reader deduplication."""
    audience = GRAPH if graph else ARM
    result, seen = [], set()
    for page in reader.pages(request, audience + endpoint, audience=audience,
                             next_key='@odata.nextLink' if graph else 'nextLink'):
        for row in page:
            rid = sw18._opaque(row.get('id')) if opaque or not graph else _guid(row.get('id'))
            rid = rid.casefold()
            if rid in seen:
                raise ValueError('duplicate native identity')
            seen.add(rid)
            result.append(row)
    return result

def _source(projection, name):
    rows = [s for s in projection['sources'] if s.get('name') == name]
    _require(len(rows) == 1, 'missing or duplicate native source: ' + name)
    source = rows[0]
    if name in GRAPH_READS:
        expected, audience = GRAPH_READS[name], GRAPH
    elif name.startswith('requirements:'):
        expected, audience = '/beta/users/' + _guid(name.split(':', 1)[1]) + '/authentication/requirements', GRAPH
    elif name.startswith('owners:'):
        expected, audience = '/v1.0/groups/' + _guid(name.split(':', 1)[1]) + '/owners?$select=id', GRAPH
    elif name.startswith('group_'):
        operation, pid = name[len('group_'):].split(':', 1)
        _require(operation in ('eligibilityScheduleInstances', 'assignmentScheduleInstances'), 'unknown PIM group source')
        expected, audience = '/v1.0/identityGovernance/privilegedAccess/group/' + operation + '?' + urlencode({'$filter': "principalId eq '" + _guid(pid) + "'"}), GRAPH
    elif name.startswith('arm_'):
        operation, pid = name[len('arm_'):].split(':', 1)
        _require(operation in ARM_READS, 'unknown ARM grant source')
        api, version = ARM_READS[operation]
        expected, audience = '/providers/Microsoft.Authorization/' + api + '?' + urlencode({'api-version': version, '$filter': "principalId eq '" + _guid(pid) + "'"}), ARM
    elif name.startswith('binding:'):
        parent = name.split(':', 1)[1]
        expected, audience = parent + '?api-version=' + ('2022-12-01' if parent.startswith('/subscriptions/') else '2020-05-01'), ARM
    else:
        _require(False, 'unknown native source')
    _require(source.get('endpoint', '').casefold() == expected.casefold() and source.get('audience') == audience, 'native source request scope differs')
    _require(source.get('status') in ('collected', 'empty') and isinstance(source.get('items'), list)
             and (source['status'] == 'empty') == (not source['items']), 'incomplete native source: ' + name)
    _require(source.get('method') == 'GET' and source.get('body') is None, 'native source was not read-only')
    return source['items']

def _source13():
    # Reuse the already admitted registrar namespace; importing the original
    # decorated module would attempt duplicate registration.
    module = sys.modules.get('peaso.checks._bulk_pending_compliance_new_sw13')
    _require(module is not None, 'admitted source13 helper namespace unavailable')
    return module

def evaluate_native(cid, item, index):
    """Return None only for historical indexes without the successor inventory."""
    if cid not in IDS:
        return None
    envelopes = index.get('collections', {}).get(KIND)
    if envelopes is None:
        return None
    from ..checks.facts import Unavailable
    try:
        context = index.get('context', {})
        metadata = context.get('metadata', {})
        tenant = _guid(metadata.get('tenant_id'))
        _require(context.get('provider') == 'azure' and metadata.get('tenant_verified') is True, 'authenticated native tenant unavailable')
        scope = str(context.get('scope', '')).casefold()
        _require(scope == '/tenants/' + tenant or str(metadata.get('subscription_tenants', {}).get(scope, '')).casefold() == tenant,
                 'selected scope not bound to tenant')
        _require(len(envelopes) == 1, 'native enforcement inventory ambiguous')
        env = envelopes[0]
        _require(env.get('scope', '').casefold() == '/tenants/' + tenant and env.get('service') == 'Microsoft.Graph'
                 and env.get('status') == 'collected' and len(env.get('items', [])) == 1, 'native enforcement inventory incomplete')
        projection = env['items'][0]
        for value in (env, projection):
            proof = value.get('_provenance', {})
            _require(proof.get('adapter') == ADAPTER and proof.get('tenant_verified') is True and proof.get('read_only') is True
                     and _guid(proof.get('tenant_id')) == tenant
                     and all(proof.get(k) == metadata.get(k) and bool(metadata.get(k)) for k in ('credential_context_id', 'customer_context_id')),
                     'native enforcement capture differs')
        _require(projection.get('id') == '/tenants/' + tenant + '#identity-enforcement', 'native projection identity differs')
        native_context = {**context, 'scope': '/tenants/' + tenant}
        native_index = _native_index(projection, native_context)
        users = _unique(_inventory(native_index, 'directory_user', endpoint=True))
        raw_users = _unique(_source(projection, 'users'))
        _require(set(users) == set(raw_users) and all(type(raw_users[rid].get('accountEnabled')) is bool and raw_users[rid]['accountEnabled'] == users[rid].get('accountEnabled') for rid in users), 'native user projection contradicts raw complete source')
        uid = _guid(item.get('id'))
        _require(uid in users and users[uid] == item, 'native user absent or contradicts authoritative source')
        now = sw18._time(projection['_provenance'].get('observed_at'))
        _require(now <= sw18._time(context.get('created_at')), 'native evidence captured after snapshot')
        return _direct(projection, item, tenant, now) if cid == DIRECT else _mfa(projection, item, native_index, cid, now)
    except (Unavailable, ValueError, KeyError, TypeError) as exc:
        return 'UNKNOWN', {'reason': str(exc)}

predecessor_conservation.note: Original reports, native XML/log, historical CASES and all MANIFEST/SPEC pins remain unchanged. The old20 native UNKNOWN-only cases for these4 open gaps are superseded by this matrix, not edited or counted as positive evidence.

proof_limits: All owned tests use real AzureTransport GET Request construction and JSON decoding through an exact fake opener; socket/DNS/auth discovery hardblocked. 215 native transport tests and16 explicitly post-native imported-capture corruption tests total231; many tests capture more than once. No live tokens, resources, calls, writes, grants or event delivery.

This is a configured authentication-obligation proof, not an assertion that a particular live sign-in succeeded, challenged a user or acquired effective access. Registration capability alone is not MFA enforcement.

Only native unconditional all-resource/all-client MFA requirements with supported direct user/transitive-group selectors and exact AND/OR or resolved strength contracts can PASS. Unsupported role selectors, app bundles/exclusions, device/location/risk/authentication-flow conditions remain UNKNOWN unless an independent universal rule suffices.
Explicit unconditional Block alongside MFA is UNKNOWN: an unreachable universe is not counted as MFA compliance. The frozen signed predecessor uses the same conservative distinction.
Security Defaults alone has unresolved per-context applicability; enabled/omitted/malformed defaults do not produce optimistic PASS or absence FAIL.

Enabled/enforced/unreadable legacy per-user MFA prevents the ALL negative CA-gap conclusion; only actual beta disabled status permits that branch. CIS additionally reports a decisive legacy-status FAIL for proven privileged directory users with disabled per-user MFA.

Unresolved ARM writer classification with disabled legacy state remains UNKNOWN. No effective writer flag is synthesized from a declared conditional role assignment or NotActions subtraction. Enabled/enforced native legacy state satisfies that stricter requirement independently of a writer classification.

PIM intervals are evaluated at captured observed_at, not current replay time. Future/expired grants do not become current; inverted/naive/missing timestamps are UNKNOWN. Null active start needs the existing exact current role-assignment corroboration; eligibility is never assumed activated.

Current eligible Global Administrator activation, role-assignable-group ownership and unexpanded PIM group paths are UNKNOWN. Native active root Global Administrator direct/transitive group paths are supported; non-admin or disabled-user applicability stays decisive.

Direct-grant absence requires complete directory/PIM sources and documented tenant-root principal-filtered ARM assignment/active/eligible reads, not a selected-subscription or accessible-subscription-list shortcut. Root read denial/partial pages remain UNKNOWN; returned subscriptions/management groups need native tenant parent binding.
The beta requirements and privilege-definition APIs are version-sensitive. Unknown state/type or unavailable beta data remains UNKNOWN; no source defaults are invented.

Provider portal mandatory MFA prevents inferring a real ADMIN console bypass solely from missing CA. This does not generalize platform MFA to all Azure API/read-only/mobile/client paths; the exact current scope is recorded separately.

No company approval/designation evidence is intrinsically required by these universal/provider-readable branches. Organization-specific sign-in obligations beyond native universal coverage remain outside the bounded proof; no invented context registry is accepted.
